title: MASEMiner — TAS-20
tagline: Extract TAS-20 factor loadings, inter-factor correlations, and study metadata for MASEM
description: TAS-20-tuned MASEMiner variant. Item content is pre-loaded so the model can recognise reordered or paraphrased items, and the standard three-factor item-to-factor mapping (DIF / DDF / EOT) is baked in as a CFA fallback. Best for meta-analyses of Toronto Alexithymia Scale studies.
task_description: Extract TAS-20 factor-analytic data: item-level factor loadings (F1.1–F5.20), inter-factor correlations (R1.2–R4.5), and study/sample metadata for every sample reported in the paper.
context: Papers report TAS-20 psychometric / factor-analytic studies. Standard three-factor structure: F1 = DIF, F2 = DDF, F3 = EOT. Item content is pre-loaded so the model can match reordered or paraphrased items.
